children: Flying Tulip's full financial stack, including ftUSD, Lend, spot and leverage trading, and TRS, goes live on Ethereum and Sonic, with USDC and ftUSD deposits earning stated APYs onchain. The launch brings the protocol's lending and trading services to two major venues in one release.

The deployment widens Flying Tulip's distribution beyond a single chain and routes deposit and trading revenue from Ethereum and Sonic into FT buybacks. Deposits flowing in from both venues give a clearer path for protocol-driven FT demand.
Users can assess the stated APYs directly onchain, since rates and balances are verifiable rather than reported offchain.
Capital always finds a way. Earn more onchain.
Flying Tulip is bringing its full financial stack to Ethereum and Sonic, with BSC coming soon: ftUSD, Lend, Trade with spot and leverage, and TRS.
— USDC on Lend APY: 3.55% Ethereum / 7.84% Sonic

title: Ethereum: Flying Tulip's full stack with ftUSD, Lend, and TRS goes live - 21 Sep 2026
